definition: The visible physical degradation that occurs when geneware or cosmetic biotech is financed on installment and the provider remotely throttles the modifications as payment lapses — resulting in patchy pigmentation loss, asymmetrical features, or fading bioluminescent implants.
origin: Geneware industry term that migrated to street slang as a mark of shame or sympathy
usage: Tier 1–3 communities where financed geneware is common; used with both derision and solidarity
example: You could see the chromatic debt along her jaw — three months behind on the Helix installment, and her whole left side was fading back to base.
